summary: AZTA 10-K is structurally honest about most distress but materially understates how rapidly conditions would deteriorate. Within 5 months of filing: $149M goodwill impairment, FY26 guidance cut 4-7pp on growth and 300-425bps on EBITDA margin, long-range plan slipped from 2028 to 2029, B Medical Systems sale failed to close (buyer financing collapsed), Multiomics president departed. Compounding all this: three concurrent unremediated material weaknesses with serial revisions of historical financials. Single bull-side data point is a Form 4 code-P open-market purchase of $163,800 by director William Cornog on 2026-05-19 (6 days before cutoff) — Cornog is a Politan-appointed member of the new Value Creation Committee, so this is a credible turnaround vote. CEO, CFO, and other directors did NOT buy. Balance sheet is genuinely strong ($546M liquid, $1.7B equity, no debt distress) — this is a strategy/governance/controls story, not a solvency story. NEUTRAL tier: too many SEVERE findings for a LONG, but Cornog buying + strong balance sheet + activist-driven governance reset block a clean SHORT. The 'honesty-alpha' read is that management is admitting more bad news (impairment, guidance cut) than they hid, so the SHORT thesis is largely priced in (-50.8% drawdown).
